title: The Occupant of Room 412

beats.text: Elena preferred the quiet of the West Wing, where the air tasted of floor wax and stale lilies. This story is a work of fiction.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome dark hospital hallway with fog

beats.text: Room 412 had been a storage closet for a decade, yet tonight the call button pulsed a steady, rhythmic amber.
beats.image_prompt: glowing call light on a dark hospital door monochrome

beats.text: The bed is still warm, she whispered to the empty corridor, a habit born of years spent tending to the dying.
beats.image_prompt: nurse silhouette in dark hallway monochrome

beats.text: She unlocked the door, expecting a short circuit, but found the thin mattress perfectly indented by a lingering weight.
beats.image_prompt: empty hospital bed with body impression monochrome

beats.text: Elena smoothed the sheets, her fingers trembling as she felt a pulse of genuine, human heat beneath the linen.
beats.image_prompt: close up of hand touching bed sheet monochrome
dark empty hospital room corner monochrome

beats.text: She saw her own name on the whiteboard under a discharge date from November 2026 and realized the mirror held no reflection.
beats.image_prompt: whiteboard with name and date in dark room monochrome

beats.text: Elena wasn't the nurse on duty; she was the patient who simply refused to clock out.
beats.image_prompt: empty hospital corridor fading into black fog monochrome

disclosure: An original fictional horror story. Visuals are illustrative.
